## Online presence

The bot's presence can be changed here. Free for all users.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Invisible makes your bot look offline in Discord, even though it is running and commands still work.
{% endhint %}

## Status text

{% hint style="warning" %}
Only [premium](/premium/priority-hosting.md) users can change their bot's status!
{% endhint %}

### Clear the status text

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FnN5tOhDruCiofNlADNAT%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20211036.png?alt=media&amp;token=562a085c-7be2-4104-8d19-24b0fa58f837" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Selecting this toggle will clear the bot's status and only change the selected online presence.

### Status field

This is where you can enter a new status for your bot. Leaving this field empty will keep the existing status and only change the online presence.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FRuYLdG6OUZyc7T1DIthy%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20211336.png?alt=media&amp;token=0edd688c-5e4b-447a-a8dd-160ed182666a" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% hint style="info" %}
If using the Streaming Status Type, you must input a twitch.tv or youtube.com link, or the bot will revert to the Playing status.
{% endhint %}

### Keep it after a restart

This toggle will ensure the updated status survives a bot restart. If toggled off, the bot will revert to its status defined by the [status module](/general-settings-and-collaboration/status.md).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FaA15offC3hJ4TWieyvcs%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20213338.png?alt=media&amp;token=615e284e-73d9-4d8a-bfe4-fc17429fcb03" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
